error.title: Something went wrong
error.hint: Please try again. If the problem continues, contact support and quote the reference below.

restricted.title: Not found or you don't have access
restricted.hint: The item may not exist, or your current roles do not include access to it. If you think you should have access, ask the project manager.

conflict.title: This record was changed by someone else
conflict.hint: Your change was not saved. Reload the latest version, review it, and apply your change again if it is still needed.

ruleViolation.title: The request breaks a business rule

notImplemented.body: This screen is part of implementation phase {phase} and is not implemented in this build yet.
notImplemented.noFakeData: No sample or simulated data is shown here. The screen will display real records once its backend is delivered and tested.
